shipping.title: SHIPPING.
sections: Where we ship
We currently ship to addresses within the United States, including APO/FPO/DPO addresses where our carrier allows.
Processing
Orders are packed and handed to the carrier within {processingDays}, excluding weekends and US holidays. You will receive an email from us when your order ships.
Delivery
Standard delivery usually takes {deliveryDays} after dispatch. Carrier delays outside our control can occur, particularly during peak seasons.
Shipping cost
{shippingLine} The exact shipping charge and any applicable sales tax are shown at checkout before you pay.
Wrong address or lost parcels

Check your shipping address at checkout. If you spot a mistake, email {supportEmail} straight away and we will do our best to update it before dispatch. If tracking shows your parcel as lost, contact us and we will work with the carrier on a replacement or refund.

returns.title: RETURNS.
sections: Unopened products

Unopened, sealed products can be returned within {returnDays} days of delivery for a full refund of the product price. Email {supportEmail} with your order email address and we will send return instructions.
Opened products
For safety reasons we cannot accept returns of opened supplements unless the product arrived damaged, defective or incorrect.
Damaged or incorrect items
If your order arrives damaged or you received the wrong product, email {supportEmail} within 7 days of delivery with a photo, and we will send a replacement or a full refund, including shipping.
Refunds
Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method. Your bank may take 5–10 business days to show the refund. Original shipping charges are non-refundable except where the error was ours.

privacy.title: PRIVACY.
sections: What we collect

When you place an order, we receive your name, email address, phone number, billing and shipping address, and the items you bought. Card details are entered on Stripe's secure checkout page; we never see or store your full card number.
How we use it

We use your information to process payment, ship your order, send order and shipping updates, handle returns and support requests, prevent fraud, and meet legal and tax obligations. We do not sell your personal information.
Who we share it with
We share only what is needed with service providers that help us run the store: Stripe for payments, our shipping carriers and fulfillment partners, and our hosting provider.
Cookies and storage

This site stores the contents of your bag in your browser's local storage so it is still there when you return. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. Stripe sets its own cookies on its checkout page to process payment securely and prevent fraud.
Your choices

You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing {supportEmail}. We keep order records for as long as required for tax, accounting and legal purposes.

terms.title: TERMS.
sections: Using this store
By placing an order with Auctoran Labs you agree to these terms. You must be at least 18 years old to purchase from this store.
Products and use

Our products are dietary supplements intended for healthy adults. Read the full label and warnings before use and use only as directed. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use if you are pregnant or nursing, have a medical condition, take medication, or are sensitive to caffeine. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. Our products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Pricing and orders

Prices are shown in US dollars. Sales tax and shipping are calculated at checkout. We may cancel and fully refund an order if a product is unavailable, a price was displayed in error, or we suspect fraud.
Liability
To the extent permitted by law, our liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it.
Contact
Questions about these terms can be sent to {supportEmail}.
